author: Lees, J.P. and others
title: Search for B --> K(*) nu nubar and invisible quarkonium decays
abstract: We present a search for the rare flavor-changing neutral current decays B --> K(*) nu nubar using a sample of 471 x 10^6 B Bbar pairs collected with the BABAR detector at the PEP-II asymmetric-energy B Factory. We use a hadronic tagging method to fully reconstruct one B meson in the event and search for the signal decay in the remaining particles. No significant excess is observed. We set 90% confidence level upper limits on the branching fractions: B(B+ --> K+ nu nubar) < 3.7 x 10^-5, B(B0 --> K0 nu nubar) < 8.1 x 10^-5, B(B+ --> K*+ nu nubar) < 11.6 x 10^-5, and B(B0 --> K*0 nu nubar) < 9.3 x 10^-5.
